verdict.rationale: Stating covered filings, states, and up-front pricing is a fair question for a registered-agent filing service, so the axis applies. The only probe was blocked at robots.txt by a Cloudflare challenge, leaving no first-party evidence of state coverage, filing scope, or pricing. The community comment about SEO is not about this story and is ignored.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the filing service states which filings and states it covers and what it costs before I buy it
